title: Onboarding Flow Development, Meeting Intelligence Solution, and Q3 Budget Review
agenda: New onboarding flow wireframe revisions and handoff to development
Meeting intelligence AI solution for automated minutes generation
discussion_points: Sarah's design team completed the onboarding wireframe and received feedback on mobile layout requiring another revision cycle. Estimated 3-4 days to complete revisions with Thursday as target delivery date to developers.
Anas confirmed backend team can work in parallel on API endpoints using existing database schema from old flow, requiring approximately one week for completion.

Omar presented a meeting intelligence agent solution that would automatically generate structured meeting minutes from recordings or notes using company template and push action items to planner, addressing the current time-consuming manual process.
Omar identified dependencies for the AI solution: Azure speech API access and SharePoint templates library access needed to deliver proof of concept within two-week timeline.
Q3 budget review scheduled for next Monday (2026-05-26) with Friday (2026-05-24) deadline for all department budget estimates.
decisions: Approved Sarah's plan to revise wireframes with Thursday delivery date before developer handoff
Approved parallel backend development by Anas's team starting immediately
Prioritized Omar's meeting intelligence AI solution with two-week proof of concept deadline
Meeting Lead will provision Azure resources by tomorrow (2026-05-21)
Mandatory Q3 budget submission deadline set for Friday 2026-05-24 with no exceptions
